notes.title: New Price ($5.99) and Bug Fixes for Languages
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're excited to tell you we have dropped our price to around six dollars in time for the holidays.

We have also fixed some pesky language bugs for Polish, Russian, and Ukrainian. We hope that the game can now be fully enjoyed in those languages!

- Ben, your friendly neighborhood Game Designer
